A [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''unidentified [[Muun/Legends|Muun]]''' was a member of the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. During the [[Battle of Muunilinst/Legends|Battle of Muunilinst]], this Muun oversaw the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] forces on the ground via [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]] alongside several other Muuns and a [[Unidentified Neimoidian (Muunilinst)|Neimoidian]]. When the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] managed to destroy the cannon at the base of the command center, the Muun remarked that their range was superior than what they had anticipated. Not long after, the [[The Muunilinst 10|Muunilinst 10]] was able to infiltrate the Banking Clan's command center and forced [[San Hill/Legends|San Hill]] to surrender before they arrested the leaders.
